retraction_note: v1 registry had 5 mutations based on a 15-trade cherry-picked slice. Monte Carlo on the full n=81 dataset showed 3 of those 5 strategies are actually profitable in aggregate (Breakout Momentum +12.81%, Classic Momentum +15.75%, quality-minus-junk +19.07%). Only vol-contraction-scout (n=11, -4.32%) and macd-hidden-div-scout (n=4, -8.22%) are genuinely losing. This v2 narrows to those 2 only. Inverse MC shows NO edge at aggregate (p=0.9455), so even these 2 are observation-only until n>=30 per strategy.

mutations.note: Genuinely losing but n=11 is too small to justify real-money inverse. Paper-track only.
